name: Indian Epistemology
description: The course will introduce Indian theories of knowledge dealing with the epistemological debates on the definition, classification, sources, and result of knowledge. The course also studies false cognition in Indian theories of knowledge. The course explores the scope of reconstruction of the Indian versions of virtue epistemology, social epistemology, and applied epistemology.
